summary: Frontend-only verification of the overhauled Intl Shipments detail page (IS-0012). All 6 review checkpoints pass: hero card, 7-step stepper with 4 done + 'Released' current, next-step hint, is-advance advances status Prepaid→Shipped (stepper now 5 done, Activity badge 5→6), all five tabs render expected content (Overview lines total 2/$17 + 3 recent items, Booking $8.50 prepayment, Chat send via Enter adds msg and increments Conversation badge 3→4, Docs shows 2 documents, Activity lists 7 entries), is-more menu shows 4 items, is-back returns to list where IS-0012 now shows 'Shipped' and Shipping column contains 'FOB · Ocean'. New-shipment flow opens detail in Draft with 'Mark ready' CTA and empty lines placeholder. No page errors. Screenshots captured at 1920 and 1280.

issues: Recharts prints repeated width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on Dashboard/other pages — not on Intl Shipments, but visible in console during navigation. Consider giving chart containers a min width/height.

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is a single ~322 line file which is fine, but the Detail sub-component is ~155 lines; consider splitting Detail into its own file for maintainability.

advance() uses STATUS_LABEL[x.status].toLowerCase() → STATUS_LABEL[next].toLowerCase() for the activity detail — cosmetic but 'Awaiting prepayment' becomes 'awaiting prepayment'. Fine as-is, just noting.

New shipment id generator `IS-${String(13 + list.length - SEED.length).padStart(4, '0')}` is order-dependent; if a user creates and then deletes, collisions could occur (no delete UI today so low risk).
test_credentials: Mocked auth — click Log in with empty fields (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IntlShipmentsPage Detail is now tab-based. Testids only exist for the active tab (is-lines/is-recent on overview, is-booking on booking, is-chat/is-msg/is-msg-input/is-msg-send on chat, is-docs on docs, is-activity on activity). is-more-menu appears only after clicking is-more; close via .is-backdrop.clear.
rca of the issue: N/A — all specified behaviors verified passing.
